correctness.rationale: For any nonzero evaluated term with value \(a_i\), uniqueness of the nonzero product forces its two immediate values to be \(a_{2i}\) and \(a_{2i+1}\). The capacity \(c(a_i)=2^{n-1-\lfloor\log_2 i\rfloor}\) is additive across that split, so induction bounds total leaves by \(c(a_i)\le2^{n-1}\). The balanced bottom term realizes \(2^{n-1}\) leaves at depth \(n-1\). Applying the source's Theorems 3.9 and 4.7 gives both exact parameters.
